checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same golden retriever recognisable in same pose
Contours and facial features clearer than source
must.why: Still very blurry, only slightly smoother. Little real improvement.

must.item: Fur and edges natural, no halos or invented detail
must.why: Looks smooth and painterly, with no halos, but it has no real fur detail.
The output is 480x480, which is 2x the 240 source. The aspect ratio is kept but the long edge is not 640.

faults.what: Output is still blurry and soft, so the request to fix the blurry dog is not really met. The reply claims added fur and face detail that is not visible.
Smeared, painterly texture in the grass and fur.

summary: The output is a 2x upscale to 480x480 that keeps the dog and framing, but it is still blurry and misses the 640px long edge.
